integrity: Self-contained proof and standard-library executable are embedded; finite certificate can be rerun; no formal or independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for the closed Euclidean radius-two disk in Z^2; invokes established planar Steinitz constant and exhaustive deterministic integer certificate; no claim for larger radius, and remaining risk of obscure earlier equivalent result.
title: Exact Davenport constant and all primitive zero sums in the thirteen-point lattice disk
